input: Set up a weekly cash withdrawal budget envelope

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Weekly Cash Envelope Budget System
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create a structured weekly cash withdrawal and envelope budgeting system to manage their spending in physical cash categories.

questions.title: What is your total weekly cash budget amount?
questions.description: Understand the total dollar amount the user plans to withdraw each week.

questions.title: Which spending categories will each envelope cover?
questions.description: Identify the specific budget categories the user wants to divide their cash into, such as groceries, dining, or entertainment.

questions.title: Which day of the week will you withdraw cash?
questions.description: Determine the specific day the user plans to make their weekly withdrawal to anchor the routine.

questions.title: Will you use physical envelopes or a digital envelope app?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a tangible paper envelope system or a digital equivalent like Goodbudget or YNAB.

questions.title: Which bank or ATM will you withdraw cash from?
questions.description: Find out where the user plans to get their cash to account for any fees, limits, or location logistics.

questions.title: What happens to leftover cash at the end of the week?
questions.description: Understand the user's preference for handling unspent cash, such as rolling it over, saving it, or returning it to the bank.

questions.title: What spending problem are you trying to solve with this system?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation or pain point driving the user to adopt a cash envelope method.
